name: Ethyn Ewing
summary: An American bantamweight (10-2, age 28), 2-0 in the UFC: a decision over Malcolm Wellmaker (November 2025) and a R3 TKO of Rafael Estevam (April). This is his biggest step up.

how_they_fight.Striking: Seven knockouts, spread across all three rounds (three in R1, two in R2, two in R3).
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Late finishes: knockouts in R3 against Estevam and Carrillo.

patterns: Finishes late as well as early (two R3 knockouts)
keys_to_beat: Out-class him technically and on the cards

news.text: Added to the UFC 335 main card against Kyler Phillips.

sources.title: UFC 335 main card confirmed, Charles Oliveira vs Diego Lopes officially headlines
